method: Models and prices were gathered live in October 2026 by four parallel research passes (bicycles, e-bikes, and ATVs for Great Britain and the Republic of Ireland), each required to read a real maker or major-retailer web page for every record and to record nulls rather than invent any model name, price, spec, or URL. For bicycles and e-bikes the maker's own national site (e.g. brompton.com, trekbikes.com/gb, canyon.com/en-gb, specialized.com/ie) was tried first, with a major retailer (Halfords, Evans Cycles, Tredz, Sigma Sports, e-bikesdirect.co.uk) used only when the maker had no priced UK/IE listing; e-bikes were restricted to EAPC-legal pedelecs (continuous motor power at or near 250W, assistance cutting off at or near 25 km/h, no throttle-only or faster models) and ATVs to four-wheeled quad bikes only, excluding side-by-sides. Prices recorded are each page's regular/RRP price, not a sale price, and GB ATV prices follow the page's own stated VAT treatment (many agricultural/off-road listings are ex-VAT, flagged includesTax:false) rather than an assumed convention. Several requested makes were dropped outright and are not represented at all: Islabikes (ceased selling bikes in 2023), GT and Ribble's full bicycle range (no reliable, consistent non-sale GB price could be confirmed), Arctic Cat and Access Motor (no evidence of a current UK retail channel or published price), and Linhai (no verifiable UK dealer page). Within included makes, some models or fields are missing or null where a maker's page stated a price but not a motor wattage, assist speed, or kerb weight — those gaps were left null rather than estimated.
